provenance.sourceQuality: Repository same-report breadth and relative strength, not independently synchronized ticks. AP corroborates direction; oil levels conflict. Current VXN/VIX unavailable.
provenance.marketVsCatalyst: Observed broad rebound; weekend OPEC+ and JOLTS impacts prospective.

editorial.marketOverview: The 11:34 ET repository report shows QQQ up 1.94%, SOX up 3.47% and Nasdaq up 1.76%, with 87 Nasdaq-100 constituents advancing. AP independently reports a broad rebound, with Nasdaq up 2% and S&P 500 up 1.5%, although quote times are not synchronized.
editorial.whatChanged: The prior bearish assessment lacked breadth and SOX confirmation. Both are now positive in the repository, and its score has moved from -46 premarket to +10. This materially reduces the bearish skew. Open Watch timestamp remains unchanged.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The rebound has stronger internal participation than previously established, warranting neutral rather than bearish bias. WSJ's 4.921% ten-year and 4.693% two-year yields imply 22.8 basis points of positive curve slope; restrictive policy remains a valuation headwind. Oil is lower in the repository but absolute Brent quotes conflict with AP. Fresh volatility is unavailable.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday's remaining shortened session tests whether broad gains survive the close. Monday's normal liquidity and weekend OPEC+ outcome will test follow-through. Tuesday JOLTS may reprice rates; CRDO and MRVL earnings dates remain tentative pending issuer verification.
editorial.bullCase: Persistent semiconductor outperformance and broad participation could extend the recovery if volatility cools and oil and yields stabilize. The positive breadth is more persuasive than isolated mega-cap gains.
editorial.bearCase: Holiday trading can exaggerate rebounds. A renewed oil shock, higher yields or reversal of chip leadership could restore the bearish skew; December tightening remains priced and existing AI financing and trade risks are unresolved.
editorial.watchNext: Check closing SOX relative strength, QQQ and breadth, fresh VXN/VIX, paired yields and oil contract quotes. Confirm Monday follow-through and Tuesday JOLTS and earnings timing.
